correspondence: Selected getAnswer methods, Value constructor annotations and FixedAnswerChallenge Objects.equals semantics were read using javap. Challenge templates and application.properties match the pinned source with only Maven version substitution. This is a selected-exercise audit, not a reproducible build attestation of the entire image.
notification_review: The controller invokes SlackNotificationService on successful answers. The adapter clears CHALLENGE59_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, clears Google service-account configuration, disables AWS metadata lookup and places the target on an internal network with no host mounts/socket. The proxy permits only challenges 1–3 and their static assets; other service endpoints and port 8090 are not published.
